findings.heading: Combinations analysis / 複数回答データの分析
findings.proposition: The English says the horizontal bars showing the frequency of each individual symptom are to the RIGHT of the plot; the Japanese says they are on the LEFT (左側の横棒).
findings.reader_consequence: A Japanese reader looking for the per-symptom frequency bars is directed to the opposite side of the example plot from the side the English text names, so the two editions disagree about how to read the same figure and the reader may misidentify which bars are the set-size bars.

findings.heading: Re-format values / 変数の値を変換する
findings.proposition: The English tells the reader to note TWO new columns towards the right end of the data: the pasted combined character values (all_symptoms) and the list column (all_symptoms_list); the Japanese mentions only the single rightmost list column.
findings.reader_consequence: A Japanese reader inspecting the displayed table does not know to check the intermediate all_symptoms character column created by unite(), so they cannot verify the semicolon-concatenation step that the preceding code performed and may not understand why two columns exist.

findings.heading: ggupset / **ggupset** パッケージでプロットを作成する
findings.proposition: The English locates the offline package documentation in the RStudio Help tab (`?ggupset`); the Japanese instructs the reader to run `?ggupset` in the RStudio console.
findings.reader_consequence: A Japanese reader is given a different action from the English text for reaching the offline documentation, and is not told that the result appears in the RStudio Help pane, so they may not know where to look for the output.
